steps.label: dns registry.npmjs.org
argv: timeout 15 getent ahosts registry.npmjs.org; echo rc=$?

steps.label: curl https registry
argv: rm -f /tmp/body; curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /tmp/body -w 'http_code=%{http_code} remote_ip=%{remote_ip} ssl_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n'  'https://registry.npmjs.org/is-number'; rc=$?; echo "curl_exit=$rc"; head -c 400 /tmp/body 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
steps.stderr: curl: (28) Resolving timed out after 20001 milliseconds

steps.label: curl https by ip
argv: rm -f /tmp/body; curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /tmp/body -w 'http_code=%{http_code} remote_ip=%{remote_ip} ssl_verify=%{ssl_verify_result}\n' -k 'https://104.16.0.35/'; rc=$?; echo "curl_exit=$rc"; head -c 400 /tmp/body 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
steps.stderr: curl: (28) Connection timed out after 20002 milliseconds
